_note: Copy only. The strictness ordering that the reconciliation math uses lives in code (puffpai.zone_bridge), not here, so editing this file can never loosen a posture.

postures.label: Open Yard
postures.summary: Everything you already said yes to happens without asking you again.

allows.lan_devices: Reaches any device you listed, with no prompt each time.
allows.actions: Actions that reach into the world run without a per-use prompt.
allows.egress: Outside services you switched on stay on while the bot runs.
allows.consent: Asked once, when you set it up, and not again at each use.

postures.costs: Nothing to click, but nothing to catch a mistake either. A wrong instruction reaches the world before you get a second chance to say no. Worth choosing on purpose, never by accident.

postures.label: Fenced
postures.summary: Your bot can talk to things in your house, and anything that reaches past it is gated.

allows.lan_devices: Devices on your own network are allowed.
allows.actions: Actions are gated at the boundary before they run.
allows.egress: Outside services are listed one by one, and every one starts off.
allows.consent: Asked when an action would reach past what you already allowed.

postures.costs: You will be asked to confirm now and then. That is the trade for a bot that is useful in the house without being loose about the world outside it.

postures.label: Moat
postures.summary: Only the outside services you switched on reach the internet. Your home network still works.

allows.lan_devices: Your home network works as usual: Home Assistant, your media server, your phones and your other devices at home.
allows.actions: Nothing reaches the internet unless you switched that service on yourself.
allows.egress: Only the outside services you switched on. A setting in a file cannot switch one on for you, and anything else that tries to reach the internet is stopped.
allows.consent: You switch each outside service on yourself, one at a time, and you can switch it off again at any time.

postures.costs: A new outside service does nothing until you switch it on. Good when you want to know exactly what reaches the internet, and to choose each one yourself.

postures.label: Drawbridge Up
postures.summary: Nothing reaches the internet. Your home network still works: Home Assistant, your media server, your phones and your other devices at home.

allows.lan_devices: Your home network works as usual.
allows.actions: Anything that needs the internet does not run, and your bot says so plainly instead of failing quietly.
allows.egress: None. Every outside service is off and cannot be switched on.
allows.consent: Nothing to switch on, because nothing reaches the internet.

postures.costs: Anything that needs the internet, like the weather, downloads or finding new apps, is off, and your bot tells you which things those are.
